description: Perenne de tallos erguidos y racimos de flores amarillas. / Perennial with upright stems and clusters of yellow flowers.
nativeRange: Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile y Brasil
ecology: Su floración otoñal aporta recursos cuando empieza a disminuir la oferta de otras flores. / Its autumn bloom provides resources as other flowers become less available.
wildlifeNotes: Las numerosas flores pequeñas ofrecen néctar y polen a insectos de fin de temporada. / Its many small flowers offer nectar and pollen to late-season insects.
sources: Plants of the World Online, Kew: https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:249473-1
